device.description: Quad 12-bit voltage-output DAC with serial input, double-buffered (LOADREG / LOADDACS) and asynchronous reset to zero or mid scale
device.note: dac7615.pdf (SBAS091, Burr-Brown PDS-1443C) p.1 block diagram, p.2 specifications (VDD 4.75-5.25 V, VSS 0 V or -5 V, VIH 2.4 V to VDD + 0.3 V), p.3 pin configurations and descriptions (P/U 16-pin, E 20-pin SSOP), p.9 theory of operation, p.10 timing (Table I, Figure 3), digital interface, p.11 control logic truth table (Table II), serial shift register truth table (Table III), double buffering, straight binary coding

commands.note: Figure 3 / Digital Interface (p.10): 16-bit word, A1 A0 select DAC A-D (Table II: 00 A, 01 B, 10 C, 11 D), two unused bits, D11-D0 MSB first on rising CLK; the shift register keeps the last 16 bits

pages: p.1 (block diagram), p.2 (supplies, logic levels), p.3 (pins, both packages), p.9 (operation), p.10 (timing, Table I, interface), p.11 (Tables II-III, double buffering, coding)
notModeled: analog outputs, external references VREFH/VREFL and the VSS (0 V or -5 V) supply (outputs never driven)

LOADREG (level, low = the input register selected by A1 A0 is transparent to the shift register) is not modeled: the input register is written when CS rises, as if LOADREG were pulsed after each word; data clocked while LOADREG is low (corrupting other input registers as A1 A0 flow through) is not modeled
RESET also stops the bus in the model (the datasheet leaves the shift register unchanged)
the shift register is updated bit by bit: with the load strobe low the selected register follows each new bit; the model writes when CS rises
CS and CLK are combined by an OR gate (interchangeable); CS rising while CLK is low shifts one extra bit (Table III note); the model shifts only on CLK edges while CS is low
power-on register contents are not specified (modeled as 0); RESET is recommended at start-up
TTL-compatible CMOS inputs (VIH 2.4 V, VIL 0.8 V)
variants: DAC7615 has its own datasheet; the DAC7614 is the single-buffered version (pin 13 NIC, pin 14 LOADDACS loads only the selected DAC register). DIP (P suffix) parts are not in the parts list
